scenario: [LIMP.13.2]: a `lib.Schema` head behaves as a bare one. [LCCO.5.1]: LHS bindings are in scope in a continuation body, and [LCCO.5.2]: a capture fact carries what the body reads. Rule `r` matches `jobs.Job j` and calls `svc.get` as `c1`, and `on response.ok == true` logs the bound `j.id`. A Job with id 1 is asserted and pumped, the answer of that `corr` is asserted and pumped. Exactly ["got 1"]. The break is the capture schema `$CaptureBindings_r_c0` left out because the binding's head was read only when bare. PATH PINNED: `dsc.rete.body_binding_head`, through `head_schema_name`, feeding `rule_cont_captures`.
rules_ds:
import jobs

schema Reply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    ok: Bool

service svc.get:
    kwarg k: Int
    response Reply

rule r:
    jobs.Job j
->
    call svc.get k: j.id nocooldown as "c1"
        on response.ok == true:
            log info "got {j.id}"

libraries.jobs:
schema Job scope explicit:
    id: Int
